newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Post issues NZ$70 mln seven yr bond issue - BNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ Post issues NZ$70 mln seven yr bond issue - BNZ.

text.p: State-owned New Zealand Post is issuing NZ$70 millon of eight percent April 15, 2004 bonds and may accept up to $10 million of oversubscriptions, lead manager Bank of New Zealand said on Friday.
The issue will be priced at a fixed re-offer margin of 0.57 percent over government 4/2004 bonds.
Subscriptions open on March 24 with a rate fixing on March 26.
Co-managers of the issue are Credit Suisse First Boston and The National Bank of New Zealand. The bonds are rated AA+ by Standard & Poor's.
New Zealand Post is also establishing a NZ$200 million commercial paper programme managed by the BNZ. Dealers on the programme are BNZ, National Bank and Westpac Banking Corp.
The paper issued under that programme is rated A-1+ by S&P.
